seg.notes: Segment revenues include freight, delivery & transportation revenues (Aggregates footnote), so seg.delivery_rev is null (not shown separately in the segment table; consolidated freight & delivery revenues are in is.delivery_rev). Only Aggregates has intersegment sales. Calcium segment = calcium products (Florida). Asphalt/Concrete cash GP not published in release (null).

is.notes: Pre-2018 presentation: income statement shows only 'Total revenues' (freight & delivery revenues included). is.delivery_rev = 'Freight and delivery revenues' and is.net_sales = 'Total revenues excluding freight and delivery revenues' from the release's non-GAAP gross-margin reconciliation (published figures, not computed). No noncontrolling interest (nci = 0). dps = cash dividends per share as shown in the release/10-Q statement of earnings. In the Q4-16 release restructuring charges are folded into 'Other operating income (expense), net' for Q4/FY presentation.

ebitda_bridge_lines: Gain on sale of real estate and businesses
Business interruption claims recovery, net of incentives
Fair market value adjustments for acquired inventory
eps_bridge_lines: Items included in Adjusted EBITDA above
Interest charges associated with debt refinancing
ngaap.notes: EBITDA (Vulcan definition) excludes discontinued operations: the Net earnings->EBITDA reconciliation adds back income tax (continuing ops), interest expense, net, and '(Earnings) loss on discontinued operations, net of tax' (captured in extra field ebitda_bridge_disc_ops_addback), then DDA&A. Hence the schema check ni_vulcan + tax + interest + total_dda = ebitda_pub only holds after adding ebitda_bridge_disc_ops_addback; adj_items.disc_ops is null (not an EBITDA->Adjusted EBITDA item). ebitda_bridge_lines = EBITDA->Adjusted EBITDA lines (zero lines kept as published). Q4 three-month column taken directly from the Q4-16 release (not derived). Bridge 'Diluted EPS' = diluted EPS from continuing operations. Gain on sale add-back (16.2) exceeds IS gain_sale (12.5): it includes a 4.3 plant-relocation reimbursement gain recorded in Other operating income (per Q4-17 release footnote). Q4-16 tax reflects ASU 2016-09 adoption (incl. catch-up effects); Q1-Q3 2016 records are pre-adoption as originally reported.
